description: This script generates a bundled license file for the PyTorch repository by collecting license information from various third-party files, identifying license types, and optionally including license texts.

methods.name: collect_license
methods.description: Collects license information from directories by scanning for license files and identifying license types.

methods.name: create_bundled
methods.description: Generates a bundled license report, optionally including license texts, and writes it to an output stream.

methods.name: identify_license
methods.description: Attempts to identify the license type of a given license file by analyzing its contents.
